newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction short-term federal bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction short-term federal bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday it had invited bids up to Monday for the auction of six-month short-term federal bonds.
The result of the auction will be announced on Tuesday with settlement set for Wednesday, it said.
The pre-auction target has been set at six billion rupees.
In the previous auction held on May 5, the bank accepted bids worth 13.04 billion rupees at a weighted average yield of 17.07121 percent per annum.
